sections.heading: What is Recursive types and depth limits?

blocks.text: **Recursive types and depth limits** is a compile-time TypeScript concept that erases at emit — the run-time behavior is still JavaScript. Recursive types and depth limits is where JavaScript dynamic typing surprises C# developers — implicit ToNumber, ToString, and truthiness rules that === and Object. This section defines terms before code — read the glossary, then run the snippets in Node or the browser console.
